cases.expected: Explicit user gesture/support detection and allow/deny/dismiss/revoke paths are correct on real supported browser/PWA/native surfaces.
iOS/iPadOS Home Screen Web Push and ordinary tab unsupported state are correctly distinguished without claiming native push.
Actual selected native Android permission/channel and iOS capability/environment/configuration work on the accepted signed test artifact.
Configured public browser key and server-only provider credentials match exact isolated environment; malformed/missing configuration fails safely.
Selected actual provider/SDK registration freshness/change/retirement protocol is implemented; no hard-coded obsolete token schema or trust in caller device ID.
Native wrapper does not expose a falsely successful browser Web Push path or silently enable local/tab reminder scheduling.
Own authenticated device registration/update/read/delete succeeds; anonymous/foreign user/account reassignment and server-health edits fail directly.
Main app and Business explicit sign-out retire current-device server association/browser subscription or follow a recorded safe failure recovery without blocking requested Auth sign-out.
Delayed permission/subscribe/lookup/save/reconcile completion during account switch cannot mutate or display the wrong user's device association.
Permission revocation, disabled/expired endpoint and re-registration clear stale associations/badges and respect explicit prior opt-in.
Multiple tabs/devices/accounts and unique endpoint conflicts preserve rightful binding; removing this device does not remove another valid device.
Auth expiry/forced sign-out/offline cleanup/reinstall/provider registration change cannot retain unintended cross-account delivery; recovery/retention is auditable.
Default push preview contains only approved generic copy, never payment names/amounts, workspace/customer identities, proofs or secrets.
Detailed previews follow approved recipient/device/workspace authority and actual lock-screen/foreground privacy checks.
Turning previews off after enqueue redacts pending/retried content before send; current queued settings cannot preserve stale sensitive copy.
Malformed/oversized/control-rich payloads produce bounded generic display, approved icon/tag/badge and no executable/injected navigation.
Displayed retained notifications/badges and click handling across sign-out/account switch do not disclose the previous account's financial details.
Actual payload/provider/log/ledger retention and deletion agree with operator/privacy declarations without leaking raw endpoints, keys, proof or customer contents.
Test sender authenticates actual active account before dispatch and applies authoritative per-user cooldown; wrong origin/method/token/inadequate account status are denied.
Cron sender rejects missing/wrong/empty secret and malformed source before claim/send; browser public keys cannot trigger service dispatch.
Personal/Family paid/paused/deleted/reassigned/removed/suspended/settings changes cancel stale reminders before delivery.
Business bill fully-paid/due-date/workspace/owner/member/subscription/suspension changes invalidate stale reminders.
Admin recipient active account/role/unread source and source status are revalidated; removed/suspended/inadequate-role recipients receive no unauthorized alert.
In-app invitation/notification create/read/mark-read metadata and membership acceptance remain protected; invitation visibility is not an implicit push pipeline or access grant.
Server due generation uses authoritative saved timezone/local date/delivery time and recurrence/overdue semantics without client-tab scheduling.
Unique enqueue and genuine concurrent claim/reclaim/result writes preserve claim ownership and do not overwrite a newer attempt with a stale worker result.
Temporary/permanent/no-subscription/blocked-destination/partial-device outcomes follow approved retry policy with observable correct totals.
Provider acceptance then result-write failure/timeout/process interruption recovers durably; duplicate delivery ambiguity is documented and bounded.
Stage 2 destination/DNS/TLS/proxy/redirect/runtime compatibility and legitimate provider delivery hold in actual installed senders.
Actual cron/Vault/Edge parity, failure budgets/private logs/queue age/retirement and recovery/rollback are verified without secrets or production sends.
External/wrong-origin/lookalike/path/query targets fall back safely; approved context is preserved without treating URL IDs as permission.
Valid Personal/Family reminder selects an accessible workspace and correct payment/due occurrence after current session revalidation.
Business bill route binds valid accessible workspace/bill and handles signed-out/removed/expired/deleted targets safely.
Admin alert click enforces current role/MFA/source access and notification ownership before displaying private queue data.
Old notification from another account or previously open tab cannot select a foreign workspace or reveal cached data after switch.
Valid invitation/manual sign-in/last-workspace/native return intent is retained while malformed/replayed/unavailable intent is rejected through actual platform flow.
Fresh/current/old worker and deployment markers are reconciled; actual installation/activation and shell failures recover safely.
Worker activation across tabs is tested separately from explicit page refresh, with dirty forms/in-flight operations preserved.
Offline navigation and failed Auth checks show generic connection-required UI rather than private or falsely-current financial data.
Sensitive API/private responses and cross-origin requests are not cached/intercepted incorrectly; obsolete shell caches are retired safely.
Foreground/resume/online update and last-workspace checks preserve current account/session; native bypass behavior is correct on a real artifact.
Physical browser/PWA/app closed/minimized/background/offline/relaunch states match accepted update/badge/delivery expectations; no native OTA behavior is inferred from PWA refresh.
Exact staged source/schema/grants/configuration and controlled recoverable actors/devices/subscriptions are verified before the bounded batch.
Closed/minimized real-device delivery and provider acceptance/display/interaction evidence are separately recorded for the accepted platform matrix.
Sign-out/account-switch/permission-revoke/removed-member/suspension/detailed-preview cases pass without touching retained fixtures or two conversions.
Server credentials/registration roles/channel settings and operations signals remain private with actual retention/deletion/rotation evidence.
Rollback/retry/claim recovery preserves finance/notification attribution and safely stops/restarts accepted schedules without destructive fixture cleanup.
Final signed artifact/provider/privacy/data declarations and Stage 9 broad regression/full re-audit remain required before release approval.
